description: This bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates the number of FLOPs (floating-point operations) required for various fine-tuning methods when applied to Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. The horizontal axis displays six distinct methods labeled "Full FT," "TAG," "LoRA," "MTL-FT," "QLoRA," and "Ours," arranged from left to right in descending order of computational cost. The vertical axis, labeled "# FLOPs," uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^18 to 10^20, with tick marks at intervals of 10^18, 10^19, and 10^20. Each bar represents the total FLOPs for its respective method: the "Full FT" bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 1.0 x 10^20 FLOPs; the "TAG" bar is slightly shorter, at about 8.0 x 10^19 FLOPs; the "LoRA" bar is next at roughly 7.0 x 10^19 FLOPs; the "MTL-FT" bar is at approximately 6.0 x 10^19 FLOPs; the "QLoRA" bar is at about 5.0 x 10^19 FLOPs; and the "Ours" bar, colored green, is the shortest at approximately 4.0 x 10^19 FLOPs. All bars except "Ours" are orange, while "Ours" is distinctly green, visually emphasizing its lower computational cost relative to the other methods. The chart does not include error rate or memory usage data, focusing solely on FLOPs.
